description: Expanded sibling helper bodies should be compared against a shared local inline/helper boundary.
Restoring a shared helper shape avoids leaving duplicated expanded logic in sibling functions.

preferred_shape:
PROJECT_ASSERT(0x88, obj);
/* PROJECT_ASSERT stands for the project's own assert macro; it expands to the same file, line, and condition. */
description: A direct assert block becomes the project assert macro when file, line, condition, and side effects match.
Pick the macro variant that preserves message and report side effects; do not invent a new one.
